(2) Hands are shown scooping various colors of ice cream into black bowls, highlighting flavors like green tea and berry. (3) The scene shifts to a self-service beverage area featuring buckets of wine, a beer dispenser pouring into a metal cup, and various soda and coffee machines. (4) Close-ups of warm buffet items include beef curry being poured over rice, braised pork with eggs, and spicy tofu/duck blood in a metal pot. (5) A hand selects fresh ingredients like vegetables and noodles from a large refrigerated shelf, then mixes a customized sauce with scallions in a bowl. (6) Visual focus turns to high-quality raw beef stored in a fridge and then beautifully plated slices; tongs are used to swirl the meat into a bubbling two-flavored hot pot. (7) An impressive seafood platter with assorted shrimp and squid is presented, and ingredients are shown being cooked in the broth. (8) The final sequence displays the empty, elegantly lit restaurant interior with decorative pendant lights, ending with informational text overlays.
